description:
☁️🔍 Cloud is a curious little cloud who travels the world asking the questions you never thought to ask.

What if the Moon disappeared? Why do you jolt awake when falling asleep? How do animals see colors we can't?
Every day, Cloud finds one mind-blowing fact about space, the human body, the brain, history and the wild "what-if" scenarios of science — explained in under 60 seconds.

🚀 Space  🧠 Psychology  🫀 Your Body  🏛️ History  🐙 Animal Superpowers  ❓ What If

🔔 New Short every day. Subscribe and stay curious!

Visuals and narration are created with the help of AI; every topic is researched from reputable sources.
